会社概要
カバー株式会社は、世界最大級のVTuber事務所「ホロライブプロダクション」の運営をはじめ、世界で通用する新しいバーチャルタレントの文化創出を目指す次世代のITエンターテインメント企業です。
当社が運営するVTuber事務所「ホロライブプロダクション」は、日本の他にも、インドネシアや北米に複数のバーチャルタレントが所属しており、様々なコンテンツをグローバルに配信しています。
Company Overview
COVER Corporation is a next-generation IT entertainment company that operates one of the world's largest companies that supports VTubers, hololive production. We are at the forefront of creating a new culture of virtual talents that resonates globally.
hololive production hosts numerous virtual talents not only from Japan but also from elsewhere such as Indonesia and North America. We deliver a wide variety of content on a global scale.
SUMMARY
The Sales & Licensing Associate supports the sales team in driving sponsorship and promotional partnership opportunities for hololive production talents within the North American market. This associate role is responsible for business development, creative execution of promotional activations, cross-functional project coordination, and deal management.
We are seeking a proactive licensing sales professional who can bridge the gap between corporate client goals and the unique creative landscape of Japanese IP!
※This is position is based in the USA, under the employ of COVER USA.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Identify and evaluate new promotion, licensing, and collaboration opportunities for hololive production talents within the North American market.
Proactively plan and prepare pitches to initiate partnerships that generate value to hololive production.
Ideate creative promotional concepts that resonate with the VTuber community while meeting client marketing goals.
Draft and refine scripts for live streams, short-form videos, and product reviews, ensuring alignment with both the partner's guidelines and the talent's content style.
Monitor project progress and compliance to ensure all deliverables are met according to the agreement and brand standards.
Serve as the point of contact between legal, finance, supervision, and talent managers to facilitate the smooth execution of promotional projects.
Support the team through the deal term process from initial outreach to financial negotiation.
Follow up after talent activation to compile and share detailed performance stats and insights from marketing activations.
Perform other strategic duties, ad-hoc projects, and cross-functional tasks as assigned by Headquarters, top management, and supervisor as necessary.
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY
This position has NO supervisory responsibility
QUALIFICATIONS
Education / Experience:
Required
3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, brand partnerships, or business development within the North American entertainment or gaming sector.
Proven experience in scriptwriting, talent activation management, and/or managing multi-stage projects involving various stakeholders.
Experience in managing project budgets and performing ROI analysis based on (talent) performance data.
Preferred
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Law, or a related field.
An existing network of potential marketing agencies and clients in the North American market.
Specific experience working with Japanese rights holders, anime properties, or related subculture IPs.
A genuine passion for VTubers, Japanese subculture, and the hololive production fandom.
Fundamental Skills:
Ability to lead end-to-end negotiations of business terms effectively.
Proficiency in Japanese in addition to the required English to communicate effectively with HQ and understand creative nuances is a plus.
Strong follow-up skills and the ability to manage complex timelines across different time zones.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving industry while maintaining brand integrity.
High proficiency in necessary tools to conduct tasks, including Slack, Monday.com, Microsoft Office, and more.
WORK ENVIRONMENT and PHYSICAL DEMANDS
WORK ENVIRONMENT
This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, scanners and filing cabinets. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS
While performing duties of job, employee is occasionally required to stand; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear.  Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.
TRAVEL
Domestic and/or International travel may be occasionally required for this position.

弊社が運営する「ホロライブプロダクション」のライセンスアウトによるIP二次展開を推進する部署に所属いただき、取組先の選定から企画提案、プロダクト・施策のクオリティ管理まで、一貫して担当いただきます。

「まだ、出会えていない誰かへ、ホロライブプロダクションの価値を届けにいく。」
「ファンとタレントが、ともに成長し続けられる世界をつくる。」
その実現のために必要なのは、単なる「商品化」ではありません。推しとの「新たな接点や体験価値」を生み出し、ファンとタレントのつながりをより深めながら、新しい出会いを生み出していくことが重要なミッションです。

hololive production hosts numerous virtual talents not only from Japan but also from elsewhere such as Indonesia and North America. We deliver a wide variety of content on a global scale.

■概要
当社ホロライブプロダクションのタレントと共創するゲームプロジェクトにおいて、複数プロジェクトが進行中です。いずれかのプロジェクトにおいて開発パートナーと連携しながら企画・開発からリリース後の運用まで一貫して推進いただけるリードディレクターを募集します。
ゲームプロジェクトのリリースからグロースまでリードいただき、PJリーダーとして組織の中核を担っていただくことを期待するポジションです。

会社概要
カバー株式会社は、世界最大級のVTuber事務所「ホロライブプロダクション」の運営をはじめ、世界で通用する新しいバーチャルタレントの文化創出を目指す次世代のITエンターテインメント企業です。
当社が運営するVTuber事務所「ホロライブプロダクション」は、日本の他にも、インドネシアや北米に複数のバーチャルタレントが所属しており、様々なコンテンツをグローバルに配信しています。
Company Overview
COVER Corporation is a next-generation IT entertainment company that operates one of the world's largest companies that supports VTubers, hololive production. We are at the forefront of creating a new culture of virtual talents that resonates globally.
hololive production hosts numerous virtual talents not only from Japan but also from elsewhere such as Indonesia and North America. We deliver a wide variety of content on a global scale.
仕事内容
■概要
ホロライブプロダクション公式店舗（東京駅・原宿・大阪梅田）で販売する店舗オリジナルグッズを中心に、商品の企画・開発を担当していただきます。
メーカー各社と連携し、商品の企画から発売までを一貫して担当するポジションです。ファンの皆さまに「その場所でしか手に入らない体験」を届けながら、店舗の売上をけん引する商品づくりをお任せします。
また、ご経験や適性、事業の状況に応じて、商品企画だけでなく店舗運営やプロモーションなどにも携わり、店舗に関わる幅広い経験を積むことも可能です。
■業務内容
公式店舗で販売する店舗オリジナルグッズを中心とした商品企画立案

社内関係部署との連携・折衝
